scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.build: pnpm run build:landing && pnpm run build:game && rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -rn artifacts/every-nation/dist/public/* dist/ && mkdir -p dist/end && cp -rn artifacts/end/dist/public/* dist/end/
scripts.build:landing: PORT=3000 BASE_PATH=/ NODE_ENV=production pnpm --filter @workspace/every-nation run build
scripts.build:game: PORT=3000 BASE_PATH=/end NODE_ENV=production pnpm --filter @workspace/end run build
